thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: P1 - REGION az3.europe-west - high error rate on inference-proxy (500s). Automatic failover policy recommended.
pagerduty-bot: Incident 2026-az3-500s created. Auto-escalation in 3m if unacked.
alice.h: seeing the page, pulling logs. starting investigation.
ben.ops: acked the PD incident. I'm on-call and jumping in.
carol-sre: quick check — metrics show 20% 5xx rate for az3 over the last 2m, latency spike to ~1.8s p95. Autoscaler not the issue yet. Possible NIC flaps?
dave-support: getting customer reports from dashboard: ~12 tenants with elevated error rates, some 429s likely from downstream retries. Notifying top 3 affected customers via status page.
eva-eng: on it, will try to drain traffic from az3 to az2 while we triage. starting graceful drain on LB routing.
frank-plat: re-routing plan: update routing policy for model-route -> prefer az2, then az1. Applying temporary override.
alice.h: grabbing kube-proxy and envoy logs. tailing proxy logs:
```
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=inference-proxy -c envoy --since=2m | grep "500" | head
[2026-03-15T12:05:31Z] "POST /v1/generate" 500 12ms - upstream reset
[2026-03-15T12:05:34Z] "POST /v1/generate" 500 3ms - connection reset by peer
```
carol-sre: confirmed upstream TCP resets from backend hosts in az3. NIC errors in node-exporter: if_in_errors jumped.
ben.ops: checking fabric, running quick netstat and ethtool on a host:
```
ssh node-az3-17
sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep rx_errors
# large rx_errors count
```
incident-bot: Automated mitigation suggestion: trigger routing override and scale out proxy pool in az2.
eva-eng: initiating routing override now. frank-plat applying policy update: `routes.set_preference("model-route", "az2", weight=90)`
frank-plat: policy applied, pushing to control plane.
ben.ops: starting emergency scale of inference-proxy in az2: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-proxy --replicas=20 -n redwood`
alice.h: watch logs for errors dropping as traffic shifts. running a quick smoke against az2 host: `curl -sS -X POST https://az2-proxy.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 200 OK, latency 120ms.
dave-support: status page updated: "Partial outage in eu-west-3 (az3). Traffic diverted to other zones. Some requests may see elevated latency." :information_source:
ben.ops: confirmed PD ack. Escalation timer cleared. tagging incident with `routing-fallback-activated`.
carol-sre: applying node remediation runbook: cordon problematic hosts in az3 + escalate to infra for NIC hardware check. Commands:
```
kubectl get nodes -l zone=az3 | grep node-az3
kubectl cordon node-az3-17
kubectl drain node-az3-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
eva-eng: performing canary verification for diverted traffic: sampling 200 requests, 0.5% errors, acceptable.
frank-plat: enabling autoscaling buffer on az2 proxies to absorb traffic: `hpa/inference-proxy -> min:10 max:50`
alice.h: collecting traces for affected requests and saving to S3 for postmortem.
dave-support: Customer impact quick summary for status: "~8-12% of global request volume routed to az3 experienced 5xx errors between 12:04 and 12:10 UTC. We diverted traffic at 12:08 UTC and restored normal response rates by 12:12 UTC for most customers. Some retries may have caused elevated latency until 12:20 UTC."
ben.ops: handing off to infra oncall for hardware follow-up. infra pd escalation: pagerduty-bot -> paging infra-team.
pagerduty-bot: Paging infra-admins for az3 NIC investigation.
carol-sre: marking runbook step: `fallback-activated` and `customers-notified`.
frank-plat: adding a short-term mitigation note: enable periodic control-plane health checks to detect NIC flaps earlier.
alice.h: running final checks — error rate in az3 now <0.1% and traffic stable. keeping routing override for 30m, then slow rollback if no regressions.
eva-eng: rolling a canary rollback plan: will gradually remove routing override at T+30m if stable.
dave-support: updating status page to "Degraded service resolved; monitoring." Customers asked to contact support if they still see issues.
ben.ops: incident assigned to carol-sre for postmortem. carol-sre -> owning writeup.
carol-sre: noted follow-ups: hardware ticket, add NIC metrics alert earlier, improve runbook to auto-drain on rx_errors threshold.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-az3-500s -> RESOLVED (mitigation: routing override + scale out). Duration: ~12 minutes active mitigation.
alice.h: thanks all. handing back to normal ops. :thumbsup:
